summary: Recent updates to the WebRTC web API, particularly around the RTCPeerConnection feature, have streamlined several functionalities and improved performance. Key changes include the introduction of **simplified access to the ICE connection state** (which helps monitor the connection quality) and the implementation of RTCError for DTLS, enhancing error handling during secure communications. Additionally, the code structures involving codecs and RTP header extensions have been cleaned up and restructured, which should aid in efficient handling of video formats like H.264. These adjustments not only refine the underlying code but also improve the overall robustness and reliability of real-time communications, crucial for applications like video conferencing.
